name: The 'Dutch Folly Fort', Canton
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A drawing of  the Haizhu ('sea pearl') river fort, known by Westerners as 'the Dutch folly fort', nearly opposite the Western 'Factories' in Canton (Guangzhou). On the reverse is a sketch of a barber.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
